verdict.rationale: An llms.txt at deepmind.google covers Veo-specific agent-oriented guidance: formatting rules, cinematic parameter notation, camera motion controls and lighting tokens. However, the developer API docs domain (ai.google.dev) returns 404 for llms.txt, and the probe found no OpenAPI spec there. Agent-readable coverage is therefore limited to one marketing-domain file rather than the API documentation. Missing for 10: llms.txt or agent-oriented docs on the Gemini API/Veo developer docs site, a machine-readable API spec, and hands-on confirmation of the deepmind.google/llms.txt content and depth.
